record.title: Validate one acquired-input option and guest persistence
record.intent: Test ordinary stock acceptance and reload using coherent specimen-derived identity inputs.
requirements: Execute one frozen disposable-guest experiment only, under established host-loopback child confinement. No specimen access.

Record baseline catalog, one ordinary installer call, original decoder/AES/validator witnesses, exact saved license and private-state deltas. Do not substitute the installer, verifier or query outputs.

If accepted, restart the component process and reboot the same guest. Reload existing files and modeled private state without regeneration, reinstallation or formatting; compare artifacts and option states.
Stop and retain evidence on failure, changed stock pins, journal loss, guest instability, unexpected hardware access or a policy pair differing from the exact established Frida pair.
Independently verify raw evidence; keep token and unit data private; commit and push the actual conclusion before successor execution.
acceptance: One bounded result establishes acquired-input component persistence or identifies the first reproducible failure.
